title: Upgrade Dynamics SL Data During Cloud Migration

facts.text: Run data replication on companies to migrate before starting data upgrade.
Have the SUPER permission set and complete company setup and resolve replication errors.
Dynamics SL migration transforms data for individual companies in background tasks without environment-wide user disconnection.
Complete final replication before starting data upgrade, as Dynamics SL waits for manual upgrade start.
Open Cloud Migration Management page and select Run data upgrade to schedule the data upgrade.
Use Refresh status to update progress and select SL Cloud Migration Errors or Failed Companies to investigate failures.
Failed Dynamics SL company upgrade cannot be restarted by selecting Run data upgrade again; must delete company and migrate again.
